chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Eutris remembers him as a busy boy
summary: He fought often, liked farm life and once ran away from Decatur back to the farm.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yes.
Because working with Louis Russell's band, that was a pretty famous band, so it was pretty nice to have a brother who was working with a famous band like that.
I came over here during that time. He was playing at the Saratoga Club, downstairs, and I came over here.
Can you describe anything about your early family life, what it was like, what Jay C. was like when he was a child? What was your impression?
I know he was a busy little fellow, I can tell you that! ... with the older boys.
(NOISE ON TAPE)
Did he get in fights often?
Quite often. (LAUGHTER)
But you said he was like very busy?
He was busy all the time.
Doing what?
You know we were born on a farm. He liked farm life. Yes, he did, and I remember after we moved out in Decatur, he ran away and went back down there.
To the farm?
Yes.
Who was down at the farm then?
I had a sister there.
Can you describe - what did he do when he was on the farm?
Oh, he was too small.
But he just liked it?
He liked to roam around, you know. It was a big plantation.
